name: Sovol SV08
pre_gcode: G90 ; Absolute positioning (START_PRINT might have changed it)
M190 S{bed_temp} ; Wait for bed temp
M109 S{temp} ; Wait for extruder temp
; Standard Sovol blob and purge line.
G4 P1000  ; Wait a bit to let it finish
G1 X88.000 F9000 ; Move right and then down for purge line
G1 X87.000 E20.88 F1800  ; Purge line right
G1 Y1 E0.16 F1800  ; Small movement back for next line
G1 X-87.000 E13.92 F1800  ; Purge line left
G1 Y1 E0.24 F1800  ; Small movement back for next line
G1 X87.000 E20.88 F1800  ; Purge line right
; The default start G-code uses too high flow for smaller nozzles,
; which causes Klipper errors. Scale everything back by
; (0.25/0.4)^2, i.e., for 0.25mm nozzle. This should be good
G4 P1000  ; Wait a bit to let it finish
G1 X88.000 F9000  ; Move right and then down for purge line
G1 X87.000 E8.16 F1800  ; Purge line right
G1 Y1 E0.063 F1800 ; Small movement back for next line
G1 X-87.000 E5.44 F1800  ; Purge line left
G1 Y1 E0.094 F1800  ; Small movement back for next line
G1 X87.000 E8.16 F1800  ; Purge line right
M400  ; Wait for moves to finish
